title: Site Laser Visibility value provenance and candidate WPM flag

finding.siteConsumer: sim/applyAttachments.js:571 copies LASERS[*].laserVisible to _laserVisible. ui/app.js:2095-2099 displays the label 'Laser Visibility' and tooltip 'Whether the selected laser is visible to enemies.' UI wording does not establish the source mechanic.
finding.candidateSourceField: Class_bc0062dc/Field_32cf19f5 in each exact selector WPM package. The descriptor-derived byte at offset 100 is 01 for every selected source record; the captured raw bytes match decoded and current XML values.
finding.candidateComparison: This boolean is true for all eight laser types and all nine exact mapped WPM package routes. It matches the five site-true rows and is non-discriminating for the three site-false rows: 5mw_red, 50mw_violet, and combo_red. DRSIAR 5mw_green maps both an LA-23 IR SP selector and a normal LA23PEQ selector. The normal selector is an exact candidate; exclusivity of the IR SP-named alternative to single player is not independently established, so both alternatives are retained and byte-checked without an SP-only claim. The field meaning is unknown, so this is not a proven site/source mismatch or source for the UI label.
finding.blocker: No captured field with established semantics for multiplayer enemy-visible beam/dot behavior has been identified. The known candidate flag is all-true and does not distinguish site labels. Native visibility consumer path is not mapped.

boundedCapturePlan.setup: In multiplayer, use M433 with only 5mw_red (site false) and then only 5mw_green (site true). Keep map, lighting, stance, aim direction, and background fixed. Record both the shooter's view and an enemy observer view at 5 m, 20 m, and 40 m; score beam and impact dot separately.
predictions: If enemy view shows the red beam/dot and not the green beam/dot at the same condition, the site labels need correction or their meaning differs from the tooltip.

If enemy view shows the green beam/dot but not the red beam/dot across comparable distances, the labels are empirically supported for those two multiplayer choices; this still does not establish Field_32cf19f5 semantics.
If visibility changes with distance or lighting, a single boolean is insufficient without a stated condition; record the threshold and keep the site label blocked pending a defined rule.
boundedCapturePlan.limit: Gameplay capture can test the displayed classification for these choices. It cannot prove that the all-true WPM flag is the native consumer.

finding.scopeLimit: No FX, sound, material-effect, or unrelated UI-art graph was expanded.
